senses.en: in good order, to tidy up, to put in order

notes: 原書 sause，疑為 sauce 之誤，照抄不改

senses.en: to sprout (young branches from the stump after cutting down a tree)
to poke with a stick and let fall (as the fruit of papaya)
to support a fruit tree with a pole
to send someone on an errand
to grate (as cassava) with a grater having holes
to cover a baby on the back with acoverlet
